assessmentRule: Recipient-side route classifications are conditional research labels, never send authorization. All applicable sender/controller regimes, provider policy, history, identity and exact effect authority remain gates.

sources.scope: PECR electronic mail to corporate versus individual subscribers; UK GDPR personal-data processing
sources.consentRequirement: Corporate subscriber unsolicited B2B email does not require PECR consent. Individual subscribers need consent or a fully evidenced soft opt-in.
sources.postalRequirement: This PECR guidance requires a valid opt-out address; it does not establish a universal physical-postal footer requirement.
sources.unsubscribeRequirement: Valid opt-out address; retain and screen suppression. Personal-data direct-marketing objections must be honored.
sources.exceptions: Generic corporate role inbox with no identifiable individual avoids this stated personal-data marketing issue. Named employee still corporate subscriber under PECR but personal-data duties apply.
sources.uncertainty: Legal-form/domain match and actual subscriber must be proven; other applicable sender/provider laws remain.

sources.consentRequirement: Specific recipient request for the message allows solicited email without consent or soft opt-in.
sources.postalRequirement: Valid contact address to opt out, not proven physical-address mandate here.
sources.unsubscribeRequirement: Valid opt-out contact applies even to solicited email.
sources.uncertainty: General contact publication is not consent. Broad work-with-us language must match actual message scope; it cannot establish specific solicitation automatically.

sources.effectiveDate: CAN-SPAM Act 2003; current FTC guide retrieved
sources.scope: All commercial email including individual and B2B messages, not just bulk
sources.consentRequirement: No blanket prior opt-in prerequisite in these commercial-email requirements; other laws/provider restrictions remain.
sources.identityRequirement: Accurate initiator, From/To/Reply-To/routing; truthful subject; clear advertising disclosure.
sources.unsubscribeRequirement: Clear easy opt-out, available at least 30 days, honor within 10 business days; no fee or unnecessary personal information.
sources.exceptions: Narrow transactional/relationship primary-purpose categories; ordinary sales message is commercial.
sources.uncertainty: Recipient-side compliance does not determine sender/controller foreign-law obligations.

sources.effectiveDate: Consolidation current to 2026-09-21; Act last amended 2026-01-01
sources.scope: Commercial electronic messages and express/implied consent
sources.consentRequirement: Express or statutory implied consent. Conspicuous publication requires recipient publication, no anti-CEM restriction and relevance to business/role/function/duties.
sources.identityRequirement: See CASL message content and CRTC regulations.
sources.exceptions: Existing relationship or specific statutory disclosure/publication grounds; each requires evidence.
sources.uncertainty: Public availability alone insufficient; record provenance, relevance and restriction checks.

sources.recipientClass: Organization communications and specifically solicited responses
sources.consentRequirement: Section 6 excluded for response to request/inquiry/complaint or otherwise solicited; organization-to-organization exemption requires organizations have relationship and relevant activities.
sources.identityRequirement: Do not treat research exception as provider waiver.
sources.postalRequirement: Route-specific exception assessment; provider may independently require footer.
sources.exceptions: Section 3(b) solicited; section 3(a)(ii) actual organizational relationship.
sources.uncertainty: Cold outreach between unrelated businesses is not blanket B2B exemption.

sources.authority: Department of Justice Canada / CRTC regulations
sources.identityRequirement: Sender business/person name; represented person's name and capacity if different.
sources.postalRequirement: Mailing address plus telephone, email or web contact.
sources.unsubscribeRequirement: Clearly and prominently presented, readily performed.
sources.exceptions: If impracticable, prominently linked free accessible web page may carry required details.

sources.unsubscribeRequirement: No cost; electronic address/web page valid minimum 60 days; effect without delay and no later than 10 business days, without further action.
sources.uncertainty: No unsubscribe mechanism may be fabricated.

sources.effectiveDate: Spam Act 2003 and Spam Regulations; guide date not independently established
sources.recipientClass: Recipients including business contacts; no blanket cold-B2B carveout established
sources.consentRequirement: Express or provable inferred consent before marketing. Electronic request for consent is itself marketing, so cannot bypass prerequisite.
sources.identityRequirement: Accurate business/legal sender and correct contact details valid 30 days.
sources.postalRequirement: Guide requires correct contact details; no universal physical-postal mandate established here.
sources.unsubscribeRequirement: Clear free facility, functional 30 days; honor within 5 working days; no login or extra personal information.
sources.exceptions: Provable relevant ongoing relationship supports inference; other statutory exceptions require independent proof.
sources.uncertainty: Public generic inbox is not automatic consent; do not overclaim absent current statutory exception evidence.

sources.effectiveDate: Spam Control Act 2007 current indexed consolidated text
sources.scope: Singapore-linked electronic messages; bulk unsolicited commercial messages
sources.recipientClass: Email recipients; not limited to consumer mailboxes
sources.consentRequirement: Act governs unsolicited bulk rather than universal opt-in. Requested/consented messages are not unsolicited.
sources.identityRequirement: Second Schedule accurate header/contact requirements must be verified.
sources.postalRequirement: No universal postal-footer requirement established by retrieved text.
sources.unsubscribeRequirement: Second Schedule facility 30 days, stop after 10 business days; advertisement subject label <ADV>.
sources.exceptions: Bulk same/similar subject: >100/24h, >1000/30d, >10000/year. Aggregate campaign behavior, not effect cap alone.
sources.uncertainty: Live full act returned 403; official indexed statute confirms thresholds/rules, require fresh complete extraction for promotion. No threshold evasion.

sources.consentRequirement: Business-contact information exclusion must be evaluated against context and purpose; no blanket personal email exclusion.
sources.exceptions: Official overview lists business name/title/phone/address/email/fax categories outside general data-protection scope.
sources.uncertainty: Live page JS challenge; preserve indexed-only confidence. DNC phone-number rules do not automatically apply to ordinary email.

sources.authority: Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority
sources.scope: UAE-linked electronic communications; operative duties imposed on telecom licensees; annex mobile spam
sources.recipientClass: Recipients accessed/present in UAE and messages originating there
sources.consentRequirement: Defines spam as marketing without consent; licensees must minimize spam. Mobile annex has explicit opt-in provisions.
sources.identityRequirement: No universal email-specific requirement concluded from mobile annex.
sources.postalRequirement: Not established for general B2B email by this instrument.
sources.unsubscribeRequirement: Mobile annex requirements should not be blindly transplanted to email.
sources.exceptions: Government entities communications exempt under instrument.
sources.uncertainty: This is not evidence of blanket cold-business-email permission or universal direct obligation for every overseas sender; separate personal-data/consumer/free-zone law may apply.

sources.scope: Personal-data processing; direct marketing right to stop
sources.recipientClass: Natural-person personal data; distinguish generic corporate contact
sources.consentRequirement: No cold-email permission inferred; applicable exceptions must be checked.
sources.unsubscribeRequirement: Official indexed text confirms direct marketing right to stop processing.
sources.uncertainty: Full official PDF unavailable via retrieval; laws differ mainland/DIFC/ADGM. No green classification.

sources.effectiveDate: Law 151/2020; Executive Regulations 816/2025; operative transition dates not independently verified
sources.scope: Electronically processed personal data of identifiable natural-person data subjects; EDM regime
sources.recipientClass: Natural-person data subjects; controller can be natural or juridical person
sources.consentRequirement: PDPC indexed guidance states explicit valid prior consent and EDM licenses/permits for creator/sender roles.
sources.identityRequirement: EDM sender disclosure; complete official detailed guideline extraction still needed.
sources.postalRequirement: No physical-postal rule established from retrieved text.
sources.uncertainty: Actual operator/controller/entity locations and whether message processes identifiable natural-person data are unproven. Corporate role inbox may reduce personal-data exposure but does not itself legally establish exclusion. Live portal provides no readable guideline text.

sources.consentRequirement: Conditional non-opt-in contacting practices; all relevant law remains mandatory.
sources.identityRequirement: Company name, explain outreach reason, tangible recipient value; company inbox preferred.
sources.postalRequirement: Valid physical address required by provider for non-opt-in contact.
sources.unsubscribeRequirement: Easy option; requests honored within 7 days.
sources.exceptions: No waiver inferred from geography. Account-specific written permission/limits still require existing evidence.
sources.uncertainty: Generic prohibited-activities automation language exists; exact prior support permission must bind activity. Public terms do not prove current pilot entitlement.
